paragraphs: 一眨眼，大家都不見了，只留下龍恩獨自一人在偌大的帳篷裡。龍恩也不知道該去哪裡，只好在帳篷內繞行。
龍恩走到中心樹，伸出雙手，試圖再次與樹連結，卻沒有得到什麼額外的資訊。
突然間，龍恩似乎感受到帳篷外有點動靜。他回想起艾爾比和英荻格先前對外頭的說法，雖然語焉不詳，卻都要求大家不要離開帳篷。然而，他也想不到更好的去處。
龍恩探頭到帳篷外，發現明明應該是白天的時間，外頭卻是一片黑暗。從帳篷內取出了火把，龍恩帶著火把在帳篷外遊蕩。外面什麼都沒有，只有泥土地和黑暗，而且火把不久就熄滅了，龍恩也只好再次回到帳篷內。然而，龍恩感受到帳篷外似乎有其他存在，就在他的周圍，但他不知道是什麼存在。
再次從帳篷內走出，龍恩舉著火把，開始繞行帳篷，他發現一側的篷布似乎被掀起又放下，卻看不見是什麼東西在動它，令他感到非常疑惑。同時，他也聽見了此起彼落的腳步聲，朝著帳篷前進，那感覺和他剛才感受到有別的存在很相似。
龍恩決定走到剛剛篷布被掀起的那一側，也掀起篷布，走了進去。然而，此刻他見到的帳篷內景象已和剛才截然不同。帳篷內是一片黑暗，只有正中央似乎有些亮光。而且，他的正前方，擠滿了幾乎遮住視線的人形生物，他們似乎穿著深黑色的盔甲，直挺挺地站在他面前，背對著他。龍恩聽見了熟悉的叫喊聲，似乎是來自他的夥伴們。龍恩試著推開站在他面前的黑甲人群，意外地順利，他便一路竄出人群。
與失散的夥伴重逢後，龍恩很快弄清楚從「大家消失」到現在發生了什麼事情，接著他便和其他夥伴一起支援救援居民的行動。然而，一聲慘叫吸引了大家的注目。
頭一抬，冒險者們發現一群數量多到難以計算的黑色盔甲士兵已將居民們包圍，躺在最外圍的居民已被士兵攻擊。眾人還在思索該怎麼辦，米多莉已趕緊衝到居民前，試圖擋下士兵下一波的攻勢。
經薩梅爾與英荻格評估，逃離妖精荒野回到原世界是最實際的作法。第一批撤離時，英荻格帶著YHWH、法朗茲和龍恩先回到了物質世界。
多侖維爾寒冷的風讓YHWH、法朗茲和龍恩恢復了意識。前陣子發生了什麼事？總覺得記憶模模糊糊的。旁邊那名太太又是誰？
身旁的妖精太太有些神秘，只要大家叫她「阿嬤」，說自己是大家的阿嬤。三人仍不清楚發生了什麼事；這位名叫英荻格的阿嬤雖然欲言又止，似乎也不打算多作解釋。四人走進旁邊的酒館休息，YHWH與英荻格住一間，法朗茲與龍恩住另一間。
三人擔心其他夥伴為何沒有一起回來，英荻格表示再等一陣子，先好好休息吧。
酒館旁原本綁著的勇哥，似乎已經不見了身影。
龍恩醒來後，發現法朗茲不見了，他便到酒館餐廳吃飯。酒館老闆看見他，便告訴他，法朗茲已經離開，走前說自己冒險夠了，想回家了。對於法朗茲的離開，龍恩也不知該怎麼想，於是便坐了下來好好享用早餐。
不久後，龍恩到鎮上探索，打聽到了現在是15050年，距離他記憶中上次住在這裡的15048年，竟已過了兩年。
英荻格、YHWH和龍恩繼續等待其他夥伴們歸來，卻還是什麼都沒等到。
在一陣亮光下，薩梅爾知道自己的傳送成功了。但是在他帶著大家離開妖精荒野時，他感受到了一雙手鬆開了他。波只留下一句：「對不起，我應該留在這裡繼續奮鬥。」便消失在大家的視線中。然而這痛苦的一幕，只有薩梅爾記得。
回到原世界，喜利・歐喜利和米多莉什麼都不記得了，米多莉只困惑著波怎麼不在她身邊。
三人走到酒館內，與提早回來的冒險者們相遇。這批回來的人之中，也只有薩梅爾還記得阿嬤英荻格。眾人在餐廳邊吃東西邊討論下一步，同時英荻格和薩梅爾也嘗試將妖精荒野的事和其他人說明，但這也無法完全讓大家恢復記憶。
疲憊的喜利・歐喜利決定先入住，找個房間睡，龍恩則回到自己的房內打坐。英荻格和YHWH也回到兩人共住的房間休息，薩梅爾也找了間房住下，米多莉則決定去一趟麥克嵩，想打聽點消息。
米多莉召喚出一匹馬作為坐騎，快速地奔馳到了麥克嵩。向衛兵詢問後，無法找到她過去曾去過的津菈教聚會所，同時她也打聽到月先生的辦公室似乎很久沒有人活動了。月先生似乎已經不在這裡了。沒有多少有用的消息，米多莉決定策馬回多侖維爾。
休息足夠後，薩梅爾走出了房間，回到了酒館餐廳。空蕩蕩的餐廳，有個陌生卻又熟悉的人的背影。薩梅爾感到好奇，走上前去，發現那名中年女子看向他，淚眼汪汪的。那神情，不會錯的，多麼熟悉，卻又好像在一夕之間老了好多好多。
波。
波緊緊抱住薩梅爾，並將這中間發生的事情告訴薩梅爾。
在冒險者們離開妖精荒野後，波和倖存的居民們四處逃竄，帳篷成了入侵者的大本營，而那些身著黑色盔甲的士兵們，正是拉索斯的部隊。拉索斯士兵四處追殺倖存者，倖存者也在荒野之中尋找資源。這段期間，波也練就了不少功夫。但最終，她成了唯一的倖存者，妖精荒野就這樣淪陷了，波也只好狠下心回到原世界。然而，兩個世界的時間流速又與先前不同；儘管波在妖精荒野度過了漫長歲月，她回來時，原世界距離薩梅爾傳送歸來還不到一天。
在薩梅爾的帶領下，波見到了她許久不見的夥伴龍恩、「爸爸」喜利・歐喜利，「媽媽」米多莉則還沒回來。薩梅爾表示YHWH似乎還在忙，先不要打擾。

paragraphs.quote:
「你爸在你離開後到現在都還沒睡過。」
薩梅爾, 論喜利・歐喜利

paragraphs: 薩梅爾帶著波在多侖維爾走走，來到了白醫師過去在這裡的住處。簡單探索後，波決定將這房子給拆了。波拿起手上的棍子大力敲打，同時用拳頭努力破壞，但是在薩梅爾眼中，波的行為和小孩打打鬧鬧沒什麼兩樣，因此他透過魔法，助了波一臂之力，將房子給炸了開來。
回到旅店，波和「媽媽」米多莉終於相見，而此時波已年約四十，米多莉則還是少女而已。波也盡可能詳盡地向米多莉說明了在妖精荒野到底發生了什麼事。
確定妖精荒野已無法成為去處後，冒險者們的下一步，會是哪裡？
In the blink of an eye, everyone vanished, leaving Ron alone in the enormous tent. With no idea where to go, he wandered around inside.
Ron went to the Center Tree and placed both hands on it, trying to connect again, but learned nothing more.
He suddenly sensed movement outside. He recalled Elby and Indigo's vague warnings about leaving the tent. He knew they had told everyone to stay inside, but could think of no better option.

Ron peered outside. Though it should have been daytime, everything was dark. Taking a torch from the tent, he ventured out. There was only dirt and darkness, and the torch soon went out, forcing him back inside. Yet he sensed other presences nearby, without knowing what they were.

He went out again with a torch and began circling the tent. On one side, the canvas lifted and fell, though he could see nothing moving it. Puzzled, he also heard footsteps approaching the tent, reminding him of the presences he had just sensed.

Ron reached the place where the canvas had lifted, raised it himself, and stepped inside. The scene was entirely different now: the tent was dark except for a faint glow at its center. A dense mass of humanoid figures in black armor stood rigidly with their backs to him, blocking his view. Beyond them, he heard familiar shouts from his companions. He tried pushing through the armored figures and, to his surprise, made his way out of the crowd with ease.
Reunited with his companions, Ron quickly caught up on what had happened since their disappearance and joined the effort to rescue the residents. Then a scream drew everyone's attention.

The adventurers looked up to see countless soldiers in black armor surrounding the residents. Those at the outer edge were already under attack. As the party considered what to do, Midori rushed forward to shield the residents from the soldiers' next assault.
Samael and Indigo judged that escaping to the material world was their most practical option. Indigo took YHWH, Franz, and Ron across first.
Dorrenville's cold wind brought YHWH, Franz, and Ron to their senses. What had happened recently? Their memories were hazy. And who was the woman standing beside them?

The mysterious elven woman told them to call her "Grandma"—she was everyone's grandma. They had no idea what was happening. Indigo seemed on the verge of saying more, but chose not to explain. The four entered the nearby tavern to rest. YHWH shared a room with Indigo, while Franz shared with Ron.
Worried about their missing companions, they asked why the others had not come too. Indigo told them to wait a little longer and get some rest.
Yung, who had been tied beside the tavern, was nowhere to be seen.

When Ron woke, Franz was gone. He went down to the dining room, where the tavern keeper told him his companion had left, saying he had had enough of adventuring and wanted to go home. Unsure what to make of Franz's departure, Ron sat down to breakfast.
Later, while exploring town, Ron learned that the year was now 15050—two years after 15048, when he remembered last staying at the tavern.
Indigo, YHWH, and Ron continued waiting, but their companions still did not return.

A flash of light told Samael that his crossing had succeeded. Yet as he led the others out of the Feywild, he felt a pair of hands release their grip on him. "I'm sorry. I should stay here and keep fighting," Beau said, disappearing from view. Only Samael remembered that painful moment.
Back in the material world, Siri and Midori remembered nothing of the Feywild. Midori could only wonder why Beau was no longer beside her.

The three entered the tavern and reunited with those who had returned earlier. Among the returning companions, only Samael remembered his grandmother Indigo. Over food, they discussed their next move. Indigo and Samael tried to explain what had happened in the Feywild, but could not fully restore the others' memories.

Exhausted, Siri rented a room and went to sleep, while Ron returned to his room to meditate. Indigo and YHWH went back to their shared room, and Samael found a room of his own. Midori decided to visit Macksohn in search of news.

Midori summoned a horse and rode swiftly to Macksohn. Even after asking the guards, she could not find the Keinra gathering place she had once visited. She also learned that Mr. Moon's office had apparently been empty for a long time; he seemed to have left. With little useful news, she rode back to Dorrenville.

After resting, Samael returned to the tavern's dining room. In the otherwise empty room, he spotted a figure whose back looked both strange and familiar. He approached, and a middle-aged woman turned toward him, her eyes full of tears. Her expression was unmistakable, yet she seemed to have aged enormously overnight.
Beau.
Beau hugged Samael tightly and told him what had happened since they parted.

After the adventurers left, Beau and the surviving residents fled through the Feywild. The invaders turned the great tent into their headquarters. The black-armored soldiers were Laxthos's forces, hunting survivors as they searched the wilderness for supplies. Beau honed her skills during those years, but eventually she was the only survivor. With the Feywild lost, she finally forced herself to leave for the material world. Time was flowing differently again: despite all the years she had spent there, she arrived less than a day after Samael's crossing.
Samael brought Beau to see Ron and her "dad," Siri, whom she had not seen for years. Her "mom," Midori, had not returned yet. YHWH seemed busy, Samael said, and should be left undisturbed for now.

paragraphs.quote:
"Your dad hasn't slept since you left."
Samael, on Siri

paragraphs: Samael took Beau for a walk through Dorrenville to Dr. White's former home. After a brief search, Beau decided to tear it down. She battered it with her stick and fists, but to Samael it looked little different from a child's tantrum. He lent her a hand with magic and blasted the house apart.

Back at the inn, Beau finally reunited with her "mom," Midori. Beau was now around forty, while Midori was still a teenage girl. Beau told her as much as she could about what had happened in the Feywild.
With the Feywild no longer an option, where would the adventurers go next?
